name: yukibana-cloud
description: The local stack and its checks. The app is under app/, the CLI under cli/, the database under supabase/, a desktop demo under demo/electron/.

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix app ci && npm --prefix cli ci && ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 npm --prefix demo/electron ci
scripts.check: npm --prefix app run lint && npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix app test && npm --prefix cli run lint && npm --prefix cli run typecheck && npm --prefix cli test && npm --prefix cli run build && npm --prefix demo/electron run lint && npm --prefix demo/electron run typecheck && npm --prefix demo/electron test
scripts.build: npm --prefix app ci && npm --prefix app run build
